It reads 100+ formats—including screenshots, PDFs, RAW photos, design files, Office/iWork documents, video, and audio—and turns file content into clear, searchable names. Batch rename mixed folders, watch folders for new files, build templates with 145+ Naming Blocks, preview every change, and undo anytime. Choose App Cloud, bring a Gemini/Groq/OpenAI/Claude key, or run workflows locally with Ollama. Free for 50 renames.
